summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change set queue_max from 1000 to 0, so every new order was dropped from the queue ('queue full, message dropped') after order 17.
recommended: Identify the dropped orders (created but never enqueued, order ids 18 to 38 and any later ones) and have them resubmitted or reprocessed by a human or the owning team
Add validation so queue_max cannot be set to 0

payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v1
queue_max: 0
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
queue_max: 0 -> 1000. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
